limitations: O59 button loss excludes targets incompatible with the sampled trigger; O39 uses all valid targets.
O59 validation conditions on observed future returns; O39 has no return conditioning.
Validation data, context length, action codec, and within-frame factorization differ.
The original O39 fit uses mean loss over offsets 1..16 plus 0.5 times mean loss over 17..36; it is not a frame +4 fit.
O59 is not included in either the original fit or its residuals. No conversion to the original weighted NLL is claimed.
W&B reports both O59 runs as crashed despite endpoint validation logs; these rows establish measured progress, not launch success.

compute_convention: Training FLOPs use each run's approximate parameter-use formula. O59 cooldown compute is cumulative from update zero, including its stable parent.

conditioning_protocol.dropout: independent CPU generator, per context position
conditioning_protocol.evaluation: positive p90 at every replan; separate unconditioned comparison
conditioning_protocol.modulation: per-block RMSNorm affine, 128-wide SiLU, biased zero-initialized projections
conditioning_protocol.availability: full observed horizon or known terminal with zero rewards thereafter
